password_reset.subject: Reset your password
password_reset.intro: We received a request to reset the password of your Technical College Portal account. Use the button to choose a new password.
password_reset.expiry: The link works once and expires in :minutes minutes.
password_reset.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email and nothing will change.

email_changed.subject: Your login email was changed
email_changed.intro: The login email of your Technical College Portal account was just changed to :new_email. From now on, sign-in and password resets use the new address.
email_changed.sessions: All other devices were signed out.
email_changed.not_you: If you didn't make this change, contact the college administration immediately so they can secure your account.

verify_email.subject: Confirm your new email address
verify_email.intro: You asked to use this address as the login email of your Technical College Portal account. Confirm it with the button (you'll need to be signed in).
verify_email.expiry: The link works once and expires in :minutes minutes.
verify_email.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email; the account keeps its current address.
